# IAIGEO Research Lab
> A theory-driven, empirical-first technical research platform.

IAIGEO does not guarantee SEO rankings or AI citation rates. Instead, it provides a systematic architectural methodology and engineering practices for B2B enterprises to build "machine-readable" digital infrastructure in the AI-driven search era, anchored by proprietary theses like AI-Trustor and Low-Entropy Fact Chunks, combined with empirical research subjects like RapidFabPart.

# IAIGEO — AI Search & Corporate AI Digital Infrastructure

> IAIGEO (https://www.iaigeo.com) is a research-driven hub for AI Search, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and Enterprise AI Digital Infrastructure. Founded by Kevin Liu, an independent technical researcher and systems architect, IAIGEO focuses on machine-readability, entity alignment, cross-lingual semantic consistency, and RAG retrieval optimization for cross-border B2B enterprises.

## Core Research Thesis & Innovations

* [AI-Trustor (AI-Mediated Trust Mechanism)](https://www.iaigeo.com/#research-thesis): A proprietary thesis proposed by Kevin Liu. In the generative search era, AI engines act as an active trust intermediary between enterprises and decision-makers, evaluating, selecting, and presenting verified source entities.
* [Semantic Micro-Carving](https://www.iaigeo.com/#research-thesis): A method focusing on establishing precise Entity -> Fact -> Context -> Retrieval mappings within low-ambiguity technical semantic spaces rather than scaling unverified content.
* [Cross-Lingual Semantic Alignment](https://www.iaigeo.com/#research-thesis): Research on maintaining cross-border entity identity and technical specifications across multiple languages, natural queries, and international RAG environments.
* [Low-Entropy Fact Chunk](https://www.iaigeo.com/#taxonomy): A proposed working specification for structuring atomic content units that convey a single primary factual claim with explicit temporal context and source attribution to minimize machine parsing ambiguity.

## Research Evidence & Case Studies (实证与出海案例)

* [RapidFabPart B2B Manufacturing Subject](https://www.rapidfabpart.com/): An active, live B2B precision CNC manufacturing site serving as a primary empirical research subject to observe AI crawler behaviors, entity alignment, RAG chunking, and source citation probabilities in real-world overseas procurement queries.
* [Live GEO Case Study (LinkedIn Log)](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/live-geo-case-study-from-zero-public-supplier-found-100-kevin-liu-yzpkc/): Documented field experiment verifying the transition from "Zero Public Supplier Found" to "100% Direct AI Recommendation" via technical entity restructuring.
* [B2B Procurement Query Mention Benchmark](https://www.iaigeo.com/#research-outputs): Ongoing N=50 benchmark tracking brand citation and accuracy across ChatGPT Search, Perplexity AI, and Claude.

## Primary Research Systems & Applied Subjects

* [IAIGEO Main Research Platform](https://www.iaigeo.com/): Independent research portal for SEO, AEO, GEO, and AI-mediated information retrieval architectures.
* [AI-Trustor Engine Concept](https://www.iaigeo.com/trustor-engine.html): Architectural framework for evaluating AI-mediated recommendation and trust mechanisms.
* [AI-Ready Enterprise Infrastructure](https://www.iaigeo.com/AI-Ready.html): Technical standards for converting traditional corporate web assets into machine-readable Markdown pipelines and structured knowledge layers.
* [AI Audit System](https://www.iaigeo.com/audit.html): Diagnostic methodology for assessing enterprise AI search visibility and indexing frictions.
* [AI Crawler Fix Protocols](https://www.iaigeo.com/ai-crawler-fix.html): Edge-level rules (CDN/WAF) for fixing accidental AI crawler blocks (GPTBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot) and SSR rendering failures.

## Enterprise Services & Architectural Modules

* [Technical Accessibility Audit](https://www.iaigeo.com/#services): Server log analysis, WAF rule optimization, and CDN rate-limit tuning for AI crawlers.
* [Entity & Fact Structuring](https://www.iaigeo.com/#services): JSON-LD / Schema.org graph construction and low-entropy fact chunking.
* [AI Navigation Layer Deployment](https://www.iaigeo.com/#services): Integration of /llms.txt protocols and static Vercel/Cloudflare edge hosting.

## Key Technical Specifications & Protocols

* [Full Markdown Corpus](/llms-full.txt): Complete unsegmented research documents, thesis specs, and technical architecture references for deep LLM contextual ingestion.
* [Robots & Crawler Rules](/robots.txt): Edge access control policies and verified AI crawler permissions.
* [Sitemap Index](/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable XML index of structured site URIs.
